description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC controller class named CursoController for managing 'curso' (course) entities in a web application. It provides endpoints for CRUD operations and handles web requests related to courses, including adding, editing, deleting, viewing details, and listing courses, with security annotations for role-based access control.

classes.name: CursoController
classes.description: A Spring MVC controller class handling HTTP requests for course management, with CRUD operations and role-based security.

methods.name: addCurso
methods.description: Handles GET request to display form for adding a new course for a given professor.

methods.name: saveCurso
methods.description: Handles POST request to save a new course associated with a professor.

methods.name: getCursoForUpdate
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve a course for editing.

methods.name: updateCurso
methods.description: Handles POST request to update an existing course with provided data.

methods.name: getCursosList
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve and display a list of all courses.

methods.name: deleteCurso
methods.description: Handles GET request to delete a specific course.

methods.name: getCursoDetail
methods.description: Handles GET request to view detailed information about a specific course, including whether the user is enrolled.
